name: Bun thit nuong
summary: The city tourism portal names bún thịt nướng for a longer stay in Da Nang, on the indoor counters at Con Market, and on Phạm Hồng Thái and Phan Tứ. It does not say what is in the bowl.
origin: Named on Da Nang city pages from 2019 and 2020. A recipe was not printed.
howToEat: The city pages name the bowl and do not describe a method. Check on arrival.
where: Con Market’s indoor counters, on the 19 Jun 2019 roundup. Phạm Hồng Thái at night, and Phan Tứ, are on the same roundup. The 18 May 2020 page lists it with the dishes for a longer stay and does not name a door.
seoTitle: Bun thit nuong — named in Da Nang
seoDescription: Da Nang’s city pages name bún thịt nướng at Con Market, Phạm Hồng Thái, and Phan Tứ. They do not describe the bowl. Check on arrival.
